title: Johnny Mathis - More Johnny's Greatest Hits (Columbia) 8 Track Tape - With Cover
descriptionText: The product is an 8-track tape of Johnny Mathis's album "More Johnny's Greatest Hits" released by Columbia. The tape comes with the original cover and features classic pop music by the artist. With a red color scheme, this edition is perfect for collectors and fans of Johnny Mathis looking to enjoy his greatest hits in the nostalgic 8-track format.
